title: Canotto protocol
description: The timings and temperatures of a biga canotto dough. Every duration is a parameter, and the 19-step protocol is solved backwards from the moment the first pizza goes on the deck. Temperatures are always degrees Celsius, whatever the app is displaying.

bigaMixMin.description: Dissolving the yeast and the coarse cluster mix, in minutes.

bigaRestHours.description: Ambient rest before the biga goes cold.

bigaColdHours.description: Cold hold for the biga before the final mix.

bigaFridgeTempC.description: Temperature of the biga cold hold.

finalMixMin.description: Final mix, from tearing the biga to the tub.

benchRest1Min.description: Rest before the first coil fold.

benchRest2Min.description: Rest before the second coil fold.

oilRestMin.description: Rest under the oil veil before balling.

ballingMin.description: Time taken to divide and ball.

benchTempC.description: Temperature through the mix and bench work.

bulkColdHours.description: The cold ferment before the dough is divided, with the dough in one piece. Zero means it is balled straight off the bench and does all of its cold time as balls, which is the older shape of this protocol and the default, so a schedule written before this field existed describes the same dough. Together with coldProofHours it makes up the cold ferment after the final mix; either may be zero. The two are at the same fridge temperature, so they contribute the same maturation per hour and a flour's budget applies to their sum. What the split changes is the dough rather than the arithmetic: in bulk the gluten stays continuous, and hours after balling are hours each piece spends relaxing alone.

coldProofHours.description: The cold ferment after the dough is balled. Usually the longest phase, and the whole of the cold ferment unless bulkColdHours is set. May be zero if all the cold time is done in bulk.

fridgeTempC.description: Cold proof temperature. The single biggest lever on timing.

ddtC.description: Desired dough temperature at the end of the final mix.

freezeFlashMin.description: Uncovered flash freeze, for balls going to the freezer.

thawFridgeHours.description: Slow fridge defrost for frozen balls.

frozenTemperHours.description: Counter temper for thawed balls, longer than for fresh.
